description.value:
You scatter a wide spread of near-invisible caltrops across the ground in a 20-foot radius centered on a point within range, turning the area into difficult terrain for the duration. A creature moving into or within the area takes 2d4 kinetic damage for every 5 feet it travels there.

A creature that couldn't see the area when you cast the power must succeed on a Wisdom (Perception) check against your tech save DC to notice the caltrops before stepping into them.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 2
